name: NoderaMC Official
description: Trackers and rendezvous services run by the NoderaMC project and by contributors who have opened a pull request to be listed here.

services.name: noderamc.org
services.notes: The project's own tracker. The literal address is listed after the name on purpose: a peer whose DNS is broken or filtered still has a route, and the name still wins when it resolves.

services.name: noderamc.org
services.notes: The project's own relay. Announces itself to the tracker above, so peers normally discover it rather than reading it from here.
